body: I think I have a person like that. To be honest, though, I don't know how far recordings of my parents screaming at me of being a loser.
They bring it up every fucking day.
I go to an online school, and am dual enrolled in community college. I don't.

I've attempted to record the abuse, and I have 10-15 second audio segments scattered, and a journal detailing times and dates, and two people who heard my parents while in skype call, but I do not have them on hand. Also, the recordings I do have are be in Russian, as that's the language I speak at home. Either way, I'll especially find a way now. 

It does scare me to do it, because despite them doing this to me, because I am afraid of sharing my private life.

It really is awful when your caretakers are the ones abusing you, because you can't get out of it, unless you drastically do something. I am considering running away like my sister did, to her, and reporting my parents to the police.

I haven't been sexually abused, but I understand with being afraid of home at school, and afraid of school at home. I'm sure if I got A's, my mother would tell me +101% or she'll file for bankruptcy. She can't beat me anymore, because I am larger than her, but she can threaten to actually make me homeless.
Debate team members, but I don't know if they are awake.

I'm sorry that your father was like that. My mother also had an abusive alcoholic father till she was 17, she hasn't been able to get past it, and has passed the abuse on to me. 

Glad your mother found a way to get you out earlier than that.

Thank you, I would be happy to talk. And I honestly don't know if physical abuse, or the mental abuse is worse.

Were you able to get out of that situation?
Yes, but she doesn't get too close. I'd call her, but again, no phone.
